sloka: बबन्धुर् बन्धनीयामः च क्षोद्यान् सम्चुक्षुदुस् तदा ।बिभिदुर् भेदनीयामः च ताम्स् तान् देशान् नराः तदा ॥२-८०-१०॥
transliteration: babandhur bandhanīyāmaḥ ca kṣodyān samcukṣudus tadā ।bibhidur bhedanīyāmaḥ ca tāms tān deśān narāḥ tadā ॥2-80-10॥

translations.english: People threw bridges at places that needed to be bridged. They pulverised stones that obstructed the path and split open big stones to drain out water.
